answeredQuestions: What build gate catches wrong-hub routing and measures no-reach without making short common phrases hard failures?

statement: The checker’s multi-word inventory boundary is principled and skips bare one-word common vocabulary.
wrong-hub should fail while no-reach should remain diagnostic telemetry.
Probe execution/parse errors are silently dropped and can yield a false green result.
A full-inventory gate must reject truncated --limit runs and report inventory/generation identity.
Stable gate assertions are probe health, complete inventory, zero wrong-hub, and visible no-reach telemetry rather than frozen confidence values or hard failure on every no-reach row.

reason: It can produce false green output when the advisor daemon is unavailable.

direction: Fail the build on every no-reach row
reason: The supplied evidence shows many short fragments are below the scorer bar and this would make the gate unrunnable.

relation: unavailable backend must fail closed before route classification
static stage-1 proof precedes runtime wrong-hub/no-reach classification
